- SC-SHR-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SHR-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SHR-D-HANDSIG — bicycle hand signal arm positions shown only as pictures (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- SC-SHR-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-SHR-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the yearly count of car and commercial vehicle collisions (sec13-F30) is a statistic that changes and must be refreshed before display.
